newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Shipping company gets new gas tanker.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Shipping company gets new gas tanker.

text.p: The Latvian Shipping Company on Wednesday said that its second gas tanker Vidzeme has been launched, one of two built for the company by South Korea's Hyundai at a cost of $100 million.
Company officials would take delivery of the new ship, the Vidzeme, on July 18, Latvian Shipping said in a statement.
The vessel joins the Kurzeme, also built by Hyundai, in the fleet of the company, one of Latvia's largest state firms and reckoned to be the 19th-largest shipping company in the world.
"The purchase of the ships was a very costly project. Taken together the two vessels cost around $100 million," the statement said.
"However, the purchase allowed Latvian Shipping to increase its fleet by two new state-of-the-art ships and to re-enter the international gas transport market," it added.

It said the ships were already scheduled for their first runs and were beginning to repay their purchase costs. It said that over 10 years the company expected to repay the funds it borrowed to build them and make a 10-14 percent profit.
